name: Suppressor Skyguard
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever a player attacks you, if that player has another opponent who isn't being attacked, prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to you this combat.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a player attacks you, if that player has another opponent who isn't being attacked, prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to you this combat.

needs.what: an intervening-if condition (or value) on a 'player attacks you' trigger that asks whether the attacking player has an opponent other than you who is not being attacked this combat -- i.e. the count of the attacking player's opponents, excluding the trigger's controller, that no attacking creature (or their planeswalkers/battles) is attacking, compared > 0
needs.why_existing_wont_do: creatures_attack_player with defending: you covers 'a player attacks you', but condition_keys and value_keys have nothing that enumerates the active player's opponents and reads who is being attacked; attacked_this_turn / attackers_this_turn / count over {binding: attackers} count creatures, not unattacked defending players, and selectors are object-based so no player-level 'not being attacked' filter exists

needs.what: a one-shot effect that prevents all combat damage that would be dealt to a player (you) for the rest of the current combat
needs.why_existing_wont_do: the prevent_damage op takes only duration and player, with no combat_only narrowing and no 'this combat' duration; combat_only exists only on the prevent_damage static, which lasts while the permanent does rather than for one combat
